courses.title: Professional Building Services Engineering & BIM Coordination
courses.description: This course equips engineers with practical skills to design and coordinate a building's mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems. Participants learn to use BIM tools to identify clashes and improve collaboration between engineering disciplines.
courses.target_audience: Engineering consultancies, contractors, property developers, and multidisciplinary design firms.
courses.short_description: This course equips engineers with practical skills to design and coordinate a building's mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems. Participants learn to use BIM tools to identify clashes and improve collaboration between engineering disciplines.

courses.title: Integrated MEP Design, Analysis & Coordination
courses.description: This course focuses on the technical design and analysis of Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems. Participants learn system sizing, engineering calculations, equipment selection, technical documentation, and coordination of services.
courses.target_audience: MEP consultants, building services engineers, and specialist contractors.
courses.short_description: This course focuses on the technical design and analysis of Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems. Participants learn system sizing, engineering calculations, equipment selection, technical documentation, and coordination of services.

courses.title: Advanced Building Services Design & Digital Engineering
courses.description: This course combines traditional building services engineering with modern digital technologies such as Revit MEP, BIM coordination, and digital construction workflows. It helps professionals improve design accuracy, productivity, and information management.
courses.target_audience: Large engineering firms, developers, and organisations adopting digital engineering.
courses.short_description: This course combines traditional building services engineering with modern digital technologies such as Revit MEP, BIM coordination, and digital construction workflows. It helps professionals improve design accuracy, productivity, and information management.

courses.title: MEP Systems Design & Building Services Integration
courses.description: This course teaches professionals how mechanical, electrical, plumbing, drainage, and fire protection systems work together within a building. The focus is on system compatibility, space allocation, service routing, and avoiding conflicts during construction.
courses.target_audience: MEP contractors, installation teams, design engineers, and project managers.
courses.short_description: This course teaches professionals how mechanical, electrical, plumbing, drainage, and fire protection systems work together within a building. The focus is on system compatibility, space allocation, service routing, and avoiding conflicts during construction.

courses.title: Building Services Engineering: Design to Construction
courses.description: This course follows the entire building services process, from initial design and engineering calculations to drawings, coordination, installation requirements, and construction documentation. It connects design-office work with practical site implementation.
courses.target_audience: Construction companies, developers, engineering consultants, and site management teams.
